discourse markers are a useful source for identifying claims and premises.

the semantic groups of discourse makers which we found to be most indicative for claims and premises are: (i) those which express a speaker's attitude, (ii) those which are indicative of a speaker's epistemic stance and (iii) those which are related to the temporal and spatial context.
